_comment: THE ONE dictation://capture-missed FIXTURE, read by BOTH suites. Rust parses it in dictation/tests.rs via include_str!; TypeScript imports it in useDictation.captureMissed.test.ts. Neither side may hand-write these values. A rename of a wire key or a stage token therefore reddens both suites together, which is the whole point: the frontend picks which REMEDY to show off `stage`, so a drift that only one side notices silently tells a user to hold the key longer against a 46-second model load.
